item.text: The ResStock team recommends **at least 1,000 samples** when no analysis-specific guidance is available. This conservative default keeps sampling discrepancy at roughly 15% or less for many common quantities of interest. [ResStock FAQ](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/FAQ.html)
